summary: CustomReportRequest is a workflow component for submitting, validating, and processing custom report requests within a web-based application. It allows authenticated users (primarily staff) to request reports based on selections of departments, programs, cohorts, courses, sites, services, and specific data fields, with business rules, validations, and conditional UI elements tailored to user roles. The system supports file uploads, mandatory comments under certain conditions, and structured approval flows.
purpose: To collect structured and validated custom report requests from users, supporting a variety of report types (Placement Requests, Student, Student PR History, Staff, Site). The UI adapts based on user role and report type to ensure only valid and complete requests are submitted for further processing.
actors: User (Staff, Placement Coordinator, System Administrator, Receiving Coordinator, etc.)

workflows.name: Custom Report Request Submission
steps: Page Load: Authenticate user, initialize session, load report (existing or new).
Setup context: Fetch and bind departments, programs, cohorts, sites, agencies, services based on user access and report context.
Dynamic UI Rendering: Show/hide controls and panels based on report type selection and user role (Placement Coordinator, Receiving Coordinator, System Admin).
User Input: Complete forms for Department, Program, Cohort, Term, Course, Site, Service, Purpose, Audience, Dates, Comments, Data Fields.
File uploads: (for Student/Authorization) allow file upload and associate the file with the request.
Validation: Client and server-side validations run (required fields, data format, file type, at least one item selected in mandatory lists).
Status and Filters: User can select multiple statuses, released flags (NIS/IRP) via checkboxes and filters.
Save/Submit: On submission, parameters are consolidated and checked again; if valid, persisted to the database.
Finalize: Optionally, display additional finalize instructions or confirmation dialogs.
Error/Warning Handling: User is notified of validation failures or system issues synchronously.

business_rules: Purpose and audience are required for all report types except Student PR History.
For 'Other' report type, comments are mandatory.
At least one department/program/site/agency/service must be selected as per report type.
Specific validation groups and UI elements are toggled per report type (PR, STU, STUPH, STAFF, SITE, OTHER).
File upload required for Student Authorization when specified.
Data fields input is mandatory in all cases.
Statuses, NIS/IRP Released checkboxes are tied to user role and agency context.
Duplicate/overlapping items are merged in parameter lists.
validations: Required field validators on purpose, audience, comments, start/end/requested dates, and data field entry.
Regular expression validators on date fields and file uploads.
Custom validator ensures requested date is not before today unless user is system admin.
Server-side validation ensures at least one entry for mandatory chooser lists (departments, programs, sites, agencies, services) as per context.
Validations dynamically assigned to validation groups based on report type (e.g., PR, STU, STAFF, SITE, STUPH, OTHER).
calculations: Date fields such as start and end dates auto-populate or reset based on term selection, with logic in JavaScript (resetDates function).
Statuses and released flags aggregate selected values for parameterization.
conditions: User role (Placement Coordinator, Receiving Coordinator, or Admin) determines accessible views and editability.
Report type selection enables/disables relevant panels and fields.
Displaying past details if report type is not Student PR History.
Panels for programs, courses, sites, services, and agencies are shown based on multi-view controls and user action.
Release checkboxes only displayed if user/agency has permission.
system_behavior: Initializes UI based on report context (new or existing, user role).
Handles postbacks for dynamic list population and multi-view state changes.
Binds data sources for all chooser controls (departments, programs, sites, agencies, services) from backend.
Registers client-side scripts and variables for enhanced user interaction.
Shows/hides finalize panel based on report completion state.
Persists all request parameters and uploaded files atomically upon valid submission.
Error and warning panels update live on page interaction.
Prevents submission if validation fails at any layer.
dependencies: Data access and binding for departments, programs, cohorts, courses, sites, agencies, services.
JavaScript functions: selectFile, resetDates, checkFilters, checkRequestedDate.
Backend resource files for labels, error messages, regex patterns.
Codes helper for drop-down data population.
exceptions: Submission blocked if required fields are missing, or file uploads are invalid.
Error messages displayed for failed validation or incomplete input.
If loading fails for user/session context or backend data, page may error or show an alert.
content_gaps: No low-level data model schema or backend implementation details (e.g., field types, table structure).
Authorization logic specifics (beyond what is inferred from field/role checks) are not available.
Exact UI labels and workflow texts are inferred from resource keys, and may differ in other languages.
No detail on how reports are processed after submission/approval.
Does not describe the notification or approval/escalation process after submission.
